opencode is a harness: profiles carry an agent (fixed at creation), workspaces a default Launch {harness, profileId}; one agent process per profile and one per agent without profile (harnessesByLaunch); opencode starts serialized (database is locked); opencode found on PATH or /opt/homebrew/bin, /usr/local/bin, ~/.opencode/bin. Per user: the app forces no opencode permissions. Continue a session works for opencode unchanged. e2e/opencode.spec.ts drives opencode against e2e/scripted-model.ts (permission, show, ask, continue a terminal session), isolated from the user's opencode setup via XDG_*.

Theme choice in the sidebar footer: Light (default, even when the OS is dark), Dark, Match system; per browser (localStorage vcs-theme), applied before first render. Tokens are light-dark() pairs; the theme only sets color-scheme on :root, which canvas iframes follow. Visual review of light and dark done via screenshots. Also fixed: composer placeholder and empty timeline named Claude Code in opencode conversations.

Not propagated to the agent's own session title (ACP has no rename).

HintLayer (web/Hint.tsx): one floating hint for any [data-hint] element, 350ms on hover, instant when moving between hinted controls, on keyboard focus; hides on pointerdown/scroll/Esc/blur. Texts in web/hints.ts explain effect + mechanism for YOLO, Profile, Questions, agent config options (their own description + how it's applied), status badge, in-terminal badge, canvas controls, sidebar controls, splitter. Shell commands (toolKind execute) render as a terminal card: header with the command's description (or 'Shell command'), status dot and an exit badge (opencode rawOutput.metadata.exit; Claude's leading 'Exit code N' line; else 'failed'); dark terminal block with '<dir> $ command' and the output (console fence and ANSI codes stripped, description block excluded), first 8 lines + 'Show N more lines'; 'waiting for your approval…' while a permission is pending; no raw input/output rows. Permission cards for commands show '$ command' and the description as subject. web/shell.ts + tests/shell.test.ts (5 tests); opencode e2e asserts the card; verified once against real Claude haiku output.

Host keeps each conversation's latest ACP usage_update in memory (Conversation.contextUsage {used,size,cost}, merged like status; no longer dropped silently) and broadcasts it. Chat header shows a chip: bar + '43% · 86k / 200k', amber from 75%, red from 90%, hover explains counts, how it is reported, compaction and the reported cost. Both agents send it: Claude at each turn end/compaction; opencode when the model has a context limit. Not persisted: empty after a host restart until the next response. Tests: tests/usage.test.ts; opencode e2e (scripted model now reports 42k prompt tokens) expects '42% · 42k / 100k' + hint; agent-flow expects the Claude meter.

Enter/Queue while the agent works queues the message on the host (Conversation.queuedMessages, in memory, broadcast like status; ConversationService.send replaces deliverAsNextMessage, so canvas next-message answers use the same queue). Queue panel above the composer: Edit pulls a message back into the composer (joined with any draft), ↑ in an empty composer pulls the last one, Remove drops it; each queued message goes out when the previous turn ends, also after Stop (assumption: stopping is how you redirect). Protocol: conversation.queue.edit/remove. e2e: opencode queue test (queue 2, ↑, Edit, Remove, answer the ask, edited text sent as next turn).
Composer drafts are kept per conversation in localStorage (web/drafts.ts useDraft), so switching conversations or reloading keeps an unsent draft. Covered by the opencode queue e2e test.

Statusline row under the composer (web/Statusline.tsx). Built-in: git branch, model, context meter (moved here from the header), cost, profile. When the conversation's Claude settings (CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR from its profile env, else ~/.claude) have statusLine.type=command, the host (host/statusline.ts) runs it like Claude Code: sh -c in the workspace dir, detached (no controlling tty), Claude-Code-compatible JSON on stdin, profile env + COLUMNS/TERM, 5 s cap, output taken at exit (a disowned background job holding stdout does not block). xterm.js renders the ANSI; the terminal grows to show wrapped rows. Refresh on conversation change + every 30 s. Toggle Built-in / Your statusline (localStorage, per browser). Unattended assumptions: a configured Claude statusLine is used by default (the toggle switches back); it also runs for opencode conversations; total_duration_ms counts from conversation creation; current_usage puts all used tokens in input_tokens. Test hosts pass VCS_STATUSLINE=off unless a spec opts in. Tests: tests/statusline.test.ts (7), e2e/statusline.spec.ts.

Select options with more than 20 choices open a searchable picker (web/SearchableSelect.tsx): search box, choices grouped by provider (ACP groups, else the 'Provider/' prefix opencode uses), every typed word must match, arrows + Enter + Esc, pointer, focus returns to the button. Plain selects stay for short lists. e2e: the scripted opencode now pins enabled_providers to its own two providers (e2e + 24 spare models) — this also stops the user's own provider keys (e.g. Hugging Face) leaking 500 models into tests; opencode.spec checks search, grouping and Enter.

openSession only resumes a session the agent has recorded (a turn-end, or agent/user message chunks or tool calls, incl. replayed history); a never-prompted session gets a fresh one without the 'Could not resume' line and the ~25 s failed attempt. setProfile uses the same check (was: any user-message, which also counted a message that never reached the agent). Regression e2e in agent-flow.spec (verified it fails without the fix). Trade-off: a first turn that crashed with the host before any agent output starts fresh instead of resuming.

The canvas MCP tools now carry _meta {'anthropic/alwaysLoad': true} (host/canvas/mcp.ts), which Claude Code honours per tool (claude-agent-sdk sdk.d.ts: per-server alwaysLoad is 'applied via _meta[anthropic/alwaysLoad] on each tool'), so tool search no longer defers them. Probe on Sonnet with the user's real settings (tool search on), same prompt: without the marker the agent called [ToolSearch, mcp__canvas__show]; with it [mcp__canvas__show]. Not kept as a permanent e2e (needs Sonnet and the user's tool-search setting). opencode unaffected.
